text: The Fed turned hawkish with 9 of 18 officials projecting a rate hike while jobs badly missed expectations at just 57,000 — this stagflationary mix of weakening growth and sticky inflation (CPI still at 3.5%) means you should be cautious about adding new risk right now.
Trim QBTS — this quantum computing stock is down 32%, losing money, and 20% of shares are being bet against by short sellers, so reduce your exposure to limit further damage.
Trim IONQ — down 23% with no earnings, nearly 13% short interest, and insiders are selling their own shares, which tells you the people closest to the company aren't confident either.
Add to Eli Lilly — 45% revenue growth from its blockbuster weight-loss and diabetes drugs combined with insider buying makes this one of the strongest fundamental stories in your portfolio.
